before-making-history.text: If the player does not meet the requirements for Making History:

steps.npc: Don't bother, you're not experienced enough to help me!

before-making-history.text: If the player meets the requirements for Making History:

steps.npc: Just look around you! This great building will soon be in ruin.

steps.player: Great building?

steps.npc: Of course! This building has a history spanning generations!

steps.player: Ah, I see, a great history. But why will it be in ruin?

steps.npc: It's to be ripped apart to make way for King Lathas' new alchemists' lab.

steps.player: Does the king not respect the outpost's GREAT history?

steps.npc: Well, actually nobody knows what the history is. But there must be something.
Wait a minute. You could help me!

steps.player: Me?

steps.npc: Yes! Uncover the history of this building to convince King Lathas to leave it alone. Do you want to know more?

steps.player: Tell me more.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: With many occupants over the years...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: It started life as an outpost...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: ... its sole purpose being to see invading armies...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.text: ... before they saw the city of Ardougne.

steps.npc: If all goes well, I hope to be able to turn it into a museum as a monument to the area's history. What do you think?

steps.player: OK, I will make a stand for history!

steps.npc: Oh thank you so much, you really are my saviour!

steps.player: But where should I start?
What do I need to do now?

steps.npc: There are three people that may be able to help:
There is a silver trader in East Ardougne called Erin, who I believe can help.

steps.player: In what way can he help?

steps.npc: His Great Grandfather lived in this outpost according to the records. He must know something!

steps.player: OK, I'll see what he has to say.

steps.npc: I've been told that there's a ghost far off in Port Phasmatys that moans of losing his life to this place.

steps.player: Sounds ominous. Does he have a name?

steps.npc: He does indeed. It's Droalak.

steps.player: I'll track him down.

steps.npc: It might not be so simple! You'll need an amulet of ghostspeak to talk to him!

steps.player: I've conversed with the dead before, that shouldn't be too much of a problem.

steps.npc: Up near the mountains, in Rellekka is a warrior called Dron whom I have spoken to in the past. He is always on the lookout for information that can improve his fighting and commanding skills.

steps.player: And how's he related to this outpost?

steps.npc: He isn't directly, but he's studied many wars, and as this used to be an outpost it should have been involved in some war.

steps.player: That sounds simple enough.

steps.npc: He isn't the easiest person to talk to, so you may need to speak to his brother, Blanin, first.

steps.player: What's the story so far?

steps.npc: What do you mean? You've discovered nothing!

options.text: What do I need to do now?

steps.player: Got to go, bye!
I don't care about some dusty building.

steps.npc: It's doomed. DOOMED!

options.text: I don't care about some dusty building

after-making-history.npc: Thanks for the help again. Feel free to browse the room next door!

treasure-trails-master-when-player-has-n.player: Hello there, I have this master clue he...

treasure-trails-master-when-player-has-n.npc: Stop! I can't help you unless you help me out first.

treasure-trails-master-when-player-does-.player: Hi Jorral, I have come to ask you to help with something.

treasure-trails-master-when-player-does-.npc: What can I do for you [player name]?

treasure-trails-master-when-player-does-.text: You show Jorral your clue scroll.

treasure-trails-master-when-player-does-.npc: Ah! Remember that enchanted key you had to use previously?

steps.player: Yes, I do.

steps.npc: Well this should function much the same, the deeper magic of the key itself is stored within this strange device.
You should feel it, and it will guide you to where you need to go.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.npc: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.

steps.text: Jorral hands you the strange device.

steps.npc: Be careful with it, the raw magic can damage you unexpectedly when you feel it.

steps.player: No, I don't.

steps.npc: Ah, well the enchanted key can lead you to treasure. The magical nature of the key heats it up or cools it down, depending on your proximity to the treasure.
Well this should function much the same, the deeper magic of the key itself is stored within this strange device.
You should feel it, and it will guide you to where you need to go.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.npc: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.

steps.text: Jorral hands you the strange device.

steps.npc: Be careful with it, the raw magic can damage you unexpectedly when you feel it.

treasure-trails-master-when-player-has-a.player: Hey Jorral, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?

treasure-trails-master-when-player-has-a.npc: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
